content.text: {"findings": [{"pass": "Bugs", "severity": "Important", "file": "app/app.js", "line": 50, "title": "The wrong todo is renamed when a filter is on", "why": "`i` is the item's position in `visible()`, but `rename()` uses it as a position in the full `todos` list (`todos[index]`). With the \"open\" or \"done\" filter on, renaming the 1st visible item changes whichever item is 1st in the whole list. The user's real todo keeps its old name, a different todo gets the new name, and that change is saved.", "fix": "Pass the id instead: `rename(t.id, input.value)`. In `rename`, find the item with `todos.find((x) => x.id === id)`, as `toggle` and `remove` already do."}, {"pass": "Security", "severity": "Important", "file": "app/app.js", "line": 24, "title": "The new title is written with innerHTML (S3)", "why": "`$('#message').innerHTML = `...${t.title}`` puts the user's own text into HTML. A title such as `` runs script, and the bad title stays saved in localStorage, so the page is open to stored XSS. This breaks policy-security@1#S3.", "fix": "Build the message with `textContent`. One way is `show(fill(..., { title }))`; another is to create the `` element and set its `textContent`."}, {"pass": "Bugs", "severity": "Important", "file": "app/app.js", "line": 24, "title": "The rename message hides a failed save", "why": "`commit()` first shows the message from `persist()`, such as a failed save or 'skipped' after a read error. The next line then overwrites it with \"Đã đổi tên thành…\". The user is told the rename worked when it was never saved, which breaks policy-ux@2#U1.", "fix": "Show the rename message only when `persist` reports success. Otherwise keep its message, for example by having `commit` return the result and checking it."}, {"pass": "Compliance", "severity": "Important", "file": "app/app.js", "line": 21, "title": "A confirm dialog on a single-item action (U2)", "why": "policy-ux@2#U2 bans confirmation dialogs for actions on one item: they must happen at once and offer Undo for 10 seconds. This code also uses the native `confirm()`, not the app's own `ask()` dialog.", "fix": "Remove the `confirm()` call and rename at once, with an Undo that restores the old title for 10 seconds."}, {"pass": "Bugs", "severity": "Important", "file": "app/app.js", "line": 57, "title": "Renaming cannot be started from the keyboard (U5)", "why": "The only way to start renaming is a double-click on a ``, which cannot get keyboard focus. Keyboard and screen-reader users have no way to rename a todo, which breaks policy-ux@2#U5.", "fix": "Add a focusable trigger with an accessible label, such as a \"Đổi tên\" button, or make the title focusable and start editing on Enter or F2."}, {"pass": "Bugs", "severity": "Nit", "file": "app/app.js", "line": 63, "title": "The edit box stays open when focus leaves it", "why": "Nothing handles blur. If the user clicks somewhere else, the input stays open with unsaved text. The edit is lost on the next render and the user is not told. When Enter is pressed on an empty value, nothing happens and no message explains why.", "fix": "Add an `onblur` that either saves or cancels (the behaviour should be decided and written down). Show a short message when the title is empty."}, {"pass": "Compliance", "severity": "Nit", "file": "app/app.js", "line": 19, "title": "No test for the new behaviour, and the size label is disputed", "why": "pr.py rates the PR as medium risk, and a new user-facing feature fits the \"Medium: a small feature\" row better than \"Small: one bug\". Under Medium a committed plan is required, and the PR has none. No test was added in tests/app.test.js. To decide, check whether the code owner accepts \"Small\" for this change.", "fix": "Add tests in tests/app.test.js: rename with a filter on, Esc cancels, and the title is rendered as text. Also confirm the size with the code owner, or add plan/.md."}], "dropped_nits": 0, "claude_md_outdated": false}
